targets.rawSql:
select
  date_trunc('day', coalesce(f.actual_delivery_date::timestamp, f.updated_at, f.created_at)) as "time",
  count(*)::numeric as "Shipped orders/day"
from mart.fact_ob_order f
where coalesce(f.actual_delivery_date::timestamp, f.updated_at, f.created_at) between $__timeFrom() and $__timeTo()
  and upper(coalesce(f.status,'')) = 'PACKED'
  and f.warehouse_key in (${warehouse:csv})
  and f.client_key in (${client:csv})
group by 1
order by 1;

select
  date_trunc('day', coalesce(f.actual_delivery_date::timestamp, f.updated_at, f.created_at)) as "time",
  count(*)::numeric as "Late orders/day"
from mart.fact_ob_order f
where coalesce(f.actual_delivery_date::timestamp, f.updated_at, f.created_at) between $__timeFrom() and $__timeTo()
  and f.delivery_delay_days > 0
  and f.warehouse_key in (${warehouse:csv})
  and f.client_key in (${client:csv})
group by 1
order by 1;

panels.title: Shipped vs Late Orders by Day

targets.rawSql:
select
  date_trunc('day', f.created_at) as day,
  upper(coalesce(f.status,'UNKNOWN')) as status,
  count(*)::numeric as orders
from mart.fact_ob_order f
where $__timeFilter(f.created_at)
  and f.warehouse_key in (${warehouse:csv})
  and f.client_key in (${client:csv})
group by 1,2
order by 1,2;

with base as (
  select
    f.warehouse_key,
    upper(coalesce(f.status,'')) as status_u,
    extract(epoch from (f.updated_at - f.created_at)) / 3600.0 as pick_to_pack_hours,
    case
      when f.actual_delivery_date is not null and f.updated_at is not null
      then extract(epoch from (f.actual_delivery_date::timestamp - f.updated_at)) / 3600.0
    end as pack_to_ship_hours
  from mart.fact_ob_order f
  where f.created_at is not null
    and f.updated_at is not null
    and $__timeFilter(f.created_at)
    and f.warehouse_key in (${warehouse:csv})
    and f.client_key in (${client:csv})
)
select
  w.warehouse_id as warehouse,
  avg(case when status_u = 'PACKED' and pick_to_pack_hours >= 0 then pick_to_pack_hours end)::numeric as pick_to_pack_hours,
  avg(case when pack_to_ship_hours >= 0 then pack_to_ship_hours end)::numeric as pack_to_ship_hours
from base b
left join mart.dim_warehouse w on w.warehouse_key = b.warehouse_key
group by 1
order by 2 desc nulls last;

select
  date_trunc('hour', f.created_at) as "time",
  count(*)::numeric as volume
from mart.fact_ob_order f
where $__timeFilter(f.created_at)
  and f.warehouse_key in (${warehouse:csv})
  and f.client_key in (${client:csv})
group by 1
order by 1;

select
  f.order_id,
  f.so_code,
  w.warehouse_id,
  c.client_id,
  f.status,
  f.created_at,
  round(extract(epoch from (now() - f.created_at)) / 3600.0, 2) as age_hours
from mart.fact_ob_order f
left join mart.dim_warehouse w on w.warehouse_key = f.warehouse_key
left join mart.dim_client c on c.client_key = f.client_key
where upper(coalesce(f.status,'')) not in ('PACKED','CANCELLED')
  and f.created_at is not null
  and f.warehouse_key in (${warehouse:csv})
  and f.client_key in (${client:csv})
order by age_hours desc
limit 100;
